name: local.experian/ops-mcp-server-consumersync
description: Ops tools for Airflow DAGs, EMR Spark logs, S3 browsing, Confluence, and Azure DevOps.
title: Ops Tools (MWAA, EMR, S3, Confluence, Azure DevOps)

environmentVariables.name: AWS_REGION
environmentVariables.description: AWS region for MWAA and EMR Serverless

environmentVariables.name: DEFAULT_ENV
environmentVariables.description: Default environment when env param is omitted (dev/uat/test/prod)

environmentVariables.name: AWS_PROFILE_DEV
environmentVariables.description: AWS CLI profile for DEV account (run gimme-aws-creds -p consumersync-dev first)

environmentVariables.name: AWS_PROFILE_UAT
environmentVariables.description: AWS CLI profile for UAT account (run gimme-aws-creds -p consumersync-uat first)

environmentVariables.name: AWS_PROFILE_TEST
environmentVariables.description: AWS CLI profile for TEST account (run gimme-aws-creds -p consumersync-test first)

environmentVariables.name: AWS_PROFILE_PROD
environmentVariables.description: AWS CLI profile for PROD account (run gimme-aws-creds -p consumersync-prod first)

environmentVariables.name: MWAA_ENV_DEV
environmentVariables.description: MWAA environment name for DEV tier

environmentVariables.name: MWAA_ENV_UAT
environmentVariables.description: MWAA environment name for UAT tier

environmentVariables.name: MWAA_ENV_TEST
environmentVariables.description: MWAA environment name for TEST tier

environmentVariables.name: MWAA_ENV_PROD
environmentVariables.description: MWAA environment name for PROD tier

environmentVariables.name: EMR_LOG_BUCKET_DEV
environmentVariables.description: S3 bucket for EMR Spark logs in DEV

environmentVariables.name: EMR_LOG_BUCKET_UAT
environmentVariables.description: S3 bucket for EMR Spark logs in UAT

environmentVariables.name: EMR_LOG_BUCKET_TEST
environmentVariables.description: S3 bucket for EMR Spark logs in TEST

environmentVariables.name: EMR_LOG_BUCKET_PROD
environmentVariables.description: S3 bucket for EMR Spark logs in PROD

environmentVariables.name: EMR_LOG_PREFIX
environmentVariables.description: S3 prefix for Spark logs

environmentVariables.name: CONFLUENCE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Confluence server base URL

environmentVariables.name: CONFLUENCE_PAT
environmentVariables.description: Confluence Personal Access Token

environmentVariables.name: CONFLUENCE_SPACE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Default Confluence space key to search in

environmentVariables.name: AZDO_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Azure DevOps / TFS server base URL (including collection)

environmentVariables.name: AZDO_PAT
environmentVariables.description: Azure DevOps Personal Access Token (only needed for TFS tools — server starts without it)

environmentVariables.name: AZDO_PROJECT
environmentVariables.description: Azure DevOps project name

environmentVariables.name: AZDO_TEAM
environmentVariables.description: Azure DevOps team name (for sprint/backlog tools)
